BALOCHISTAN
ARMS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
An
Ordinance further to amend toe Balochistan
Arms
Regulation, 1940
[Gazette
of Balochistan, Extraordinary,
22nd
September, 2001]
No. Legis.2‑42/Law/79‑IV,
dated 22‑9‑2001.‑‑‑The following Ordinance made
by the Governor of Balochistan on 18th September, 2001 is hereby published for
general information:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑(1) This Ordinance may
be called the Balochistan Arms (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001. _
(2) It shall come into force on the 14th day of August, 2001.

Amendment of section 2 of Regulation III of 1940

2. Amendment of section
2 of Regulation III of 1940.‑‑In the
Balochistan Arms Regulation, 1940, in the proviso of subsection (2) of section
2 for the words "District Magistrate" the words "Provincial
Government" shall be substituted.
